professional_summary.content: Sabrina (chronological age: 2 years, 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools to evaluate developmental functioning across cognitive, motor, sensory processing, and adaptive behavior domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed both areas of emerging strength, such as social engagement and learning potential, and areas requiring targeted intervention support, including fine motor coordination, attention and focus, and communication skills. These developmental challenges may impact her functional performance and engagement in daily activities. Based on the assessment findings, occupational therapy services are recommended to support Sabrina's progress, emphasizing strategies to enhance fine motor, attentional, and communication abilities. A multidisciplinary intervention approach involving speech therapy and behavioral support services, alongside a collaborative, family-centered model, will be beneficial. It is essential for family involvement and educational support to play a part in the intervention plan to ensure seamless transition of skills in the home environment. Regular monitoring and reassessment will help track Sabrina's progress and adjust intervention strategies to achieve her developmental goals and promote functional independence.
